analogy.rationale: mTOR lies in the PI3K/AKT/mTOR growth-signaling axis, so PI3K and AKT inhibitors should phenocopy mTOR inhibition most closely, with upstream IGF-1 receptor and broad kinase inhibitors partially overlapping. mTOR inhibitors act on a well-expressed kinase and produce a measurable but often modest transcriptional response in these cell lines.
